agent.problem: The question is not self-contained: "all this" points back to the judgments described on earlier cards without identifying them. When those cards are no longer visible, the question does not adequately say what the LORD will do.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

agent.problem: Nebuchadnezzar's name has not appeared in the earlier cards and cannot be inferred from the setup. The blank therefore asks the baker to guess unseen wording rather than test a meaning they can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: The card places Shemaiah among the exiles in Babylon, but Jeremiah 29:24-25 does not state that detail. It is supported later in the passage, so the cited range does not cover everything the card tells.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
